title: hookerina gardneri
intro: Hookerina gardneri, commonly known as Hooker's fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Hooker's fern are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hooker's fern include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
